summary: Master HRIS selection, implementation, and data governance. Learn to lead digital HR transformation and People Analytics. Enroll in our 5-day expert-led course.
lede: HR systems training helps HRIS managers, technology analysts, and HR operations leaders improve systems that support employee processes. Participants practise defining requirements, mapping workflows, assessing workforce data quality, and reviewing access controls and integrations. They also develop dashboard specifications and technology roadmaps to prioritize improvements; advanced configuration and production deployment are outside the course scope.
audienceIntro: HR technology management training is designed for professionals who influence HR systems, workforce data, digital employee services, and technology-enabled people operations. It suits intermediate practitioners who can relate platform capabilities to HR processes and need a stronger method for governance, improvement, or transformation planning.
audience: Data Protection and Information Security Specialists
modules: HR Technology Roadmaps and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to HR operations, HRIS administration, HCM processes, people analytics, IT business analysis, or HR transformation. Familiarity with employee lifecycle workflows and spreadsheet-based reporting will help. No programming is required, and the course uses structured templates rather than production system configuration. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the provided worksheets to your own HR technology environment.
